Lead profile: HelpBolt Cloud — lightweight customer support automation for SMB e-commerce merchants (Shopify-first). Positioning: 'cheap, fast, easy to integrate' — they target merchants 10-200 employees. Inbound via docs/tutorial on hosted API (self-serve). Primary ask: add automated ticket summarization + ability to call external ticketing provider (tool calling) with strongly typed JSON output for downstream ingestion.

Tech stack: Node.js microservices, AWS (us-east-1), Postgres, current integrations: Intercom + Zendesk via webhooks. They plan to route through Redwood hosted API and use function-calling to create/update tickets in Zendesk; structured output must include fields: ticket_title, summary, priority, tags, customer_id.

Requirements (from CTO Maya Patel):
- Latency target: 150-300ms median for summarization endpoint (short summaries ~1-3 sentences)
- Throughput: bursty, typically 5-15 qps during peak campaigns, long-tail long-polling for async events
- Cost sensitivity: tight — want predictable per-call unit economics for SMB pricing; initial budget expectation $3k-$10k ARR first year
- Model preferences: open to smaller open models (quantized) if quality meets threshold; wants Redwood model profiles and token-cost per 1k tokens comparisons
- Reliability: automatic fallback to cheaper model variant under load; must not drop function-calls or return malformed JSON
- Security: basic SSO for admin UI, audit logging for ticket creation events; data retention controls desirable
